title: Functoriality of the explicit ordinary-etale smooth-section restriction
statement: For every finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions], every separated finite-type k-scheme B, every d >= 0, and all smooth section pairs [def-pur-section-restriction-data], the explicit ordinary-etale restriction defined by section pullback of rho composed with the exceptional compositor sends identity maps to identity isomorphisms and composite etale maps of pairs to the composite restriction isomorphisms. This assertion concerns restrictionEtale before transport to the pro-etale category.

source.place: Step 3; composition-coherence Step 1; sk-thm-dnc Local construction and Gluing

proof.text:
write E(a,g) as the specified exceptional compositor at the coefficient unit
followed by rho(a) at omega(g), inserting the congruence g' = a g. Conjugating
compact-support associativity gives the associator of the exceptional compositor.
The composition law for rho and its naturality identify E(ba,g) with
E(b,ag) followed by Lb*E(a,g), through the pullback compositor. Pull back by the
second section. Threefold pullback coherence and the section equations cancel
the intermediate compositors. The identity laws of rho, exceptional composition,
and pullback give the first clause. This uses the fixed finite coefficients and
works also in dimension zero and on the empty base; no orientation is chosen.

proof_origin.place: Local construction and Gluing, with explicit fixed-map comparisons

lean.statement: theorem restrictionEtale_functorial (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) : ∀ (B : Scheme.{u}) (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [IsSeparated aB] [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB] (d : ℕ), (∀ X : Pair B d, restrictionEtale P aB (EtaleMap.id X) = Iso.refl _) ∧ (∀ (X'' X' X : Pair B d) (b : EtaleMap X'' X') (a : EtaleMap X' X), restrictionEtale P aB (b.comp a) = restrictionEtale P aB b ≪≫ restrictionEtale P aB a)
